english.title: Supply false info to OFT / OFCOM / Commission / Secretary of State re Enterprise Act 2002 functions
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) supplied information, namely **(..SPECIFY INFORMATION..) to the

(A)_[Office of Fair Trading,]_
(B)_[Office of Communications,]_
(C)_[Competition Commission,]_
(D)_[Secretary of State,]_

in connection with functions under Part 3 of the Enterprise Act 2002, which was false or misleading, knowing or being reckless as to whether it was false or misleading in a material respect
english.legislation: Contrary to section 117(1) and (3) of the Enterprise Act 2002.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and /or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
